name: reveal
description:
Reveal an entity that exists but the player does not know yet: they notice it, are told
of it, or reach it. Prefer this over inventing a replacement.

entity_id.description: Exact id of the unrevealed canon entity.

name: move
description:
Move an actor who actually changes location, or one item within the player's reach:
picked up, set down here, or handed to an actor here. Moving the player to an unrevealed
location reveals it.

entity_id.description:
Exact id of the actor or item that moves; `player` is the played character.
An item must be one the player carries, or one loose at their location.

to_id.description:
Exact id of where it goes: for an actor the location they enter; for an item,
`player` to pick it up, an actor here with the player to hand it over, or the
player's own location to set it down.

name: gain_improvised_item
description:
Give the player an ordinary incidental object that is not in canon and is not worth a
canon entry of its own. Never a substitute for an item that already exists.

item_name.description: The object written out, such as 'a handful of gravel'.

name: add_trait
description:
Put a lasting condition, skill, or frailty on an entity. The trait shows the id written
out: `battle-worn` appears as Battle Worn.

entity_id.description: Exact id of the entity affected; an actor must be here with the player.

trait_id.description: Stable slug for the trait, such as `poisoned`.

text.description: The constraint or benefit it puts on the entity, in prose.

name: remove_trait
description: Lift a lasting condition, skill, or frailty the fiction has ended.

entity_id.description: Exact id of the entity affected; an actor must be here with the player.

trait_id.description: Exact id of a trait the entity carries.

name: advance_thread
description: Move a storyline the scenario is tracking: where it stands now, or that it is over.

thread_id.description: Exact id of one thread in ACTIVE THREADS.

status.description: Where the thread now stands, or null to leave it as it is.

stage.description: Stable slug for the point it has reached, or null to leave it as it is.

tick.description: How many segments this fills on the thread's clock, when it has one.

name: reveal_way
description:
Show the player a way through they did not know about. Call this before moving them
through a passage they have not found.

location_id.description: Exact id of the location the way leads from.

to_id.description: Exact id of the location it leads to.

name: unlock_exit
description: Open a locked way when the fiction opens it — a key turned, a bar lifted, a seal broken.

location_id.description: Exact id of the location the way leads from.

to_id.description: Exact id of the location it leads to.

name: join_party
description: Put an actor here with the player into their party; a party member travels with them.

actor_id.description: Exact id of the actor joining, who must be here with the player.

name: leave_party
description: Take an actor out of the player's party when the fiction parts them.

actor_id.description: Exact id of the actor leaving.

name: roll_attempt
description:
Put one risky attempt to the highest die of a pool. Call for one only when failing would
cost something real. Never state the outcome yourself: what comes back is what the dice
settled.

actor_id.description: Exact id of the actor attempting this: the player, or an actor here.

goal.description: What the actor is trying to do and what they risk by trying, in one line.

skill.description:
The skill on the actor's sheet this calls on, copied exactly as it is written
there. Empty when none of theirs applies: they roll the bare d6.

helped.description:
The circumstance that makes this easier — a skill, a piece of gear, the ground
they hold, an ally's presence — in a few words. Empty when nothing does, and never
alongside `helper_id`.

helper_id.description:
Exact id of an ally here who helps with this — they roll their own skill die
into the pool. Null when nobody helps.

helper_skill.description:
The skill on the *helper's* sheet this calls on, copied exactly as it is
written there. Empty when none of theirs applies: they roll the bare d6.

hindered.description:
The circumstance that makes this harder, in a few words. Empty when nothing
does.

luck_test.description:
What bad luck might arrive alongside this — running out of ammo, running
into guards. The engine rolls whether it does. Empty for no test.

name: roll_luck_test
description:
Put the SRD's standalone bad-luck test to the dice, for a turn where nothing is
attempted but bad luck might still arrive.

actor_id.description: Exact id of the actor whose luck is tested: the player, or an actor here.

subject.description:
What bad luck might arrive — running out of ammo, running into guards. The
engine rolls whether it does.

name: change_credits
description:
Move an actor's credits for gear bought, repairs paid, debts collected or pay earned —
never for a roll's own outcome, which the engine settles itself.

actor_id.description: Exact id of the actor: the player, or an actor here.

amount.description:
Positive to pay them, negative to charge them. A charge the pool cannot cover
is refused.

name: complete_job
description:
Record that the job is done — the fiction's own boundary, called once when the crew's
engagement genuinely closes, usually alongside resolving its thread. Never for a mere scene
ending.
